name: career-ops
description_en: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
